title: French Manga, Comic Creator Frédéric Boilet Dies at 66
content: Boilet was born in 1960 at Épinal in Eastern France. He began his comic career with La Nuit des Archées in 1983. He then drew Le rayon vert in 1987 and 36 15 Alexia in 1990. He collaborated with writer Peeters on several works, such as Love Hotel , Tôkyô est mon jardin , and Demi-tour . Boilet moved to Japan in 1993.
author: ANN
